definitions.explanation: Describes something that is hard to comprehend due to complexity, abstraction, or specialized content. Used for texts, theories, concepts, and similar intellectual material.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難解|なんかい}だ。
examples.english: This book is difficult to understand.

examples.japanese: {難解|なんかい}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}した→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧。
examples.english: I reread the abstruse passage many times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{哲学|てつがく}→哲学：03548_tetsugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難解|なんかい}な⟦{用語|ようご}→用語：04086_yougo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Philosophy papers contain so much abstruse terminology that even experts sometimes struggle to understand them.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ (difficult) + {解|かい} (understand, solve). Literally 'difficult to solve.'

USAGE: {難解|なんかい} is a somewhat formal word, commonly used in written Japanese and academic contexts. It modifies nouns with な.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {難解|なんかい}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧: abstruse writing
- {難解|なんかい}な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: a difficult problem
- {難解|なんかい}な⟦{用語|ようご}→用語：04086_yougo⟧: obscure terminology
- {難解|なんかい}な⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: a difficult work (of art/literature)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {難解|なんかい}: emphasizes intellectual difficulty of comprehension
- ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: general-purpose 'difficult' (broader usage)
- ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧: complex, complicated (focuses on structural complexity)
